notes.title: What's Going On?
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, just an update with where we're at with everything!
As some of you might know, we recently released our very first game Cauldron Chaos and honestly, it’s been a wild ride. We’re super grateful for everyone who’s taken the time to play it, leave feedback, or just cause total mayhem with mates (as intended 👀).

Now, we’ll be honest it’s been a little quiet on the update front lately. After launch, we took some time to regroup, plan our next moves, and just recharge a bit (turns out making games is hard, who knew?). 

We also know that the game’s launch was… well, a bit rough. There’s no hiding it bugs, missing polish, some weird multiplayer chaos (the bad kind, not the fun kind). But that’s part of making something weird and ambitious, and we’re learning fast. We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear, and we’re determined to keep improving.


🎮 A Word on Online Multiplayer
One big decision we’ve made is to leave online multiplayer in its current state for now.

It was a huge learning experience, and while it technically works, it’s not where we want it to be in terms of stability, performance, and fun. You can still play the game online, but right now, it’s not the recommended way to play. If it works for you and your friends awesome! But we know it’s a bit hit and miss, and we’re being real about that.

So instead of spreading ourselves too thin, we’re focusing on the heart of Cauldron Chaos which is couch co-op madness. That’s what this game was originally built for, and that’s where it shines.

We’ll keep online on our radar for the future, but for now, expect updates that lean into the local fun, shared screen chaos, and sofa-fight energy.


The Future!
Our studio is just getting started we’ve already begun brainstorming ideas for our next project. We’re excited about what’s ahead and can’t wait to share more when the time comes. Thanks for being part of this crazy journey with us!

Also, watch out for our Discord in the next few days we’re opening an official Play Again Studios server! It’ll be the spot for everything, developer chats and new project sneak peeks. Can’t wait to see you there!



Cheers, 

Play Again Studios.

notes.title: Cauldron Chaos - Hotfix Patch 1.0.1 🔥🧙‍♂️
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Thanks for jumping into our first ever game on steam, our first online multiplayer game as well, and we are quite happy with where it's at. It just needs a bit of polish and more content, which we are releasing soon. But right now we’ve just pushed a hotfix to patch up a few post-launch gremlins. 

Here's what we’ve fixed:

🛠️ Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the play button was un-selectable meaning the game was unplayable for a bit.
 Cleaned up some UI inconsistencies in the lobby screen.


🔮 Known Issues

Grenades Don't Sync very well on the network.
If the host leaves the game in a match the game bricks.
Characters have very bad Desync issues in multiplayer. 




Thanks again for playing and being part of this wild launch. We’re reading your feedback and working very hard behind the scenes. Stay chaotic!
— Play Again Studios
